content:
My favourite Apple TV 4K feature—the screensaver—is finally expected to get audio in tvOS 27, according to the latest leaks. Here are the details.

tvOS 27 code shows that at least one Apple TV screensaver will get an audio option, with more expected in the future

October is widely expected to be a major month for Apple, with a range of new hardware and software products set to debut.

Among the rumoured products is a new Apple TV 4K, which has already seen images leak in Apple code.

On the software side, leaker pdfu has now published evidence obtained from the tvOS 27 code showing that at least one Apple TV screensaver will gain audio support.

As you can see in the video above, the Snoopy screensaver hides an option to toggle audio on or off, or set it to a "reduced" mode.

Snoopy is a relatively non-distracting screensaver, but it's great to see Apple planning to let users turn the audio off entirely.

Although pdfu hasn't yet found audio support in other screensavers, it's highly likely Apple will expand the feature to more screensavers in the future.

What do you think about tvOS 27 potentially adding audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Share your thoughts in the comments.
